purpose: Train/test split for incident model v2. Nothing in 'test' is used to train, tune a threshold or choose features.

town05.why: Training runs set by Urban Traffic CARLA (normal town, 10 % careless drivers, 4 times of day, 2 crashes in a picture). The 50 % careless runs hold most crashes in a picture and every stage-1 clip, so they test v2 on the same videos v1 was scored on.
town05.labels: 1 while an accident is in the camera's picture (incidents.json 'visible', shown 2.2 s late); everything else 0, including the queue after the wrecks are cleared.
town05.note: The other test cameras also appear in training runs (other seed, other time of day). Fixed cameras are the real use case; results on the two unseen cameras are reported apart.

ai_city.train_videos: every other labelled video (67 videos, 14 anomaly intervals)
ai_city.why: The original v1 test split is kept as the real-video test (3 anomaly intervals). Train/val videos that share a camera with a test video (evaluation/camera_groups.json) are left out of training, so the real-video test has no camera leakage.
ai_city.note: 3 test anomalies is a very small sample; also report camera-grouped cross-validation on the training videos.

tuning: Thresholds and model choices use out-of-fold scores on training data only, grouped by Town05 run and by AI City camera.
